title: MELD: A Protocol for Merging Knowledge Across Distributed Agentic Memories -- reference implementation and experiments
description: Reference implementation and experiment harness for MELD, a knowledge-merge protocol for sovereign agent memories: the five-outcome admission procedure (insert, merge, relate, conflict, reject) over three signals (scoped claim-key identity, embedding similarity, NLI contradiction verdict), the auditable Patch, the per-claim status CRDT, and the publish/subscribe binding. Includes the 104-pair merge-classification benchmark and gold set, the order-shuffle graph-sensitivity experiment, the CRDT convergence and partition-heal drivers, the cross-tier (edge/HPC/local) deployment drivers over Apache Kafka, the M-1 HotpotQA memory-delta campaign harness, and archived per-run logs with a hashed run manifest. v1.0 accompanies the TAAS submission.
